{{Top|leg}}
'''Mercevian Nagua''' was a legendary [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]]<ref name="Lianna">''[[Mission to Lianna]]''</ref> who pioneered several assault and infiltration methods that were still used during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|356|Nagua, Mercevian}}</ref> One tactic, the [["Mercevian Nagua" method]], involved entering a building while it was still open, hiding, and then performing the robbery at night when it was closed.<ref name="Lianna" /> [[The Dagger]], also known as the Mercevian Nagua maneuver, employed a similar tactic but was used in space. It involved infiltrating a [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] aboard a target [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] to disable the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. The saboteur would arrange for the ship to exit [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] at a pre-arranged location. A variation involved placing multiple infiltrators on the ship to seize the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]].<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
